integrity: The EGF follows from an explicit two-state decomposition and the tree dissymmetry identity. Exact coefficients are independently checked by Prüfer-code and exhaustive simple-graph enumeration in small orders.
limitations: Exact labeled age enumeration only; no unlabeled or asymptotic claim. Originality remains search-bounded because a species derivation may exist under different graph terminology.
title: Exact labeled age enumerator for a weak-amalgamation forest class
